text:
Laura Chen: Heads-up — saw two small but sticky UX nits in the routing policies editor on staging: (1) keyboard focus ring on priority handles is almost invisible on dark mode, and (2) preview/simulation toasts are firing so quickly that screen readers miss the 'simulation complete' state.
Mike Patel: repro? steps + browser? :eyes:
Laura Chen: steps — open policies > add 3 rules > reorder priorities quickly using keyboard (space to grab, arrow keys) > run preview sim (quick sim config). Chrome latest, macOS.
Eva Sørensen: I saw this too. When you reorder fast the focus jumps but outline is 1px light gray. On VO it's not obvious which item is active.
Sudha Iyer: We should be careful — enterprise customers depend on keyboard flows. Can we prioritize an a11y fix before the next minor?
Mike Patel: Agreed. Quick fix idea: increase focus outline to 3px with a high-contrast color token, and ensure the grab state has aria-pressed or aria-grabbed set. Small CSS tweak: 
```
.policy-rule:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--intent-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.policy-rule[aria-grabbed=\"true\"] { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(66,153,225,0.12); }
```
Laura Chen: That CSS helps visually, but we also need the screen reader narration when reorder completes: \"Rule X moved to position Y\". Right now the preview toasts use a transient live region with \"assertive\" and it stomps on other messages.
design-bot: Accessibility scan: live region usage flagged — \"assertive\" can interrupt. Recommend \"polite\" for non-critical updates.
Eva Sørensen: For the preview simulation specifically, we want two announcements: when sim starts -> \"Simulation started\" and when it finishes -> \"Simulation complete: 12 requests simulated\". Use aria-live polite for start and assertive for final only if the sim failed. Otherwise polite avoids interrupting ongoing screen reader context.
Mike Patel: Implementation plan: 
- change focus outline tokens (PR draft in branch: fix/priority-focus)
- add aria-grabbed and keyboard helptext exposed via sr-only element when an item is grabbed
- switch sim start/finish to aria-live polite; on sim failure emit assertive error.
I can push the outline + aria-grabbed today.
Sudha Iyer: UX copy nit — current validation message when two rules have identical matchers says: \"Conflicting matchers detected\". Can we make it friendlier and actionable? e.g., \"Two rules match the same inputs — change the order or narrow the matcher to avoid ambiguity.\"\nLaura Chen: +1. Also add an inline link in the validation tooltip to docs: \"How routing precedence works\" so users can self-serve.
Eva Sørensen: One more edge: when preview is running the simulation panel collapses/expands with animation and focus sometimes gets lost off-canvas. Suggested: keep panel open during sim or trap focus inside the panel until sim completes.
Mike Patel: Trapping focus is heavier; alternative: set the panel to overflow: auto and ensure focusable sim controls remain in DOM order. I'll try to reproduce and propose minimal changes.
Laura Chen: TL;DR action list from this thread:
- Mike: increase focus outline & aria-grabbed (ETA today)
- Mike: switch sim live region to \"polite\" for normal completions; assertive only on errors (ETA this sprint)
- Mike: stop panel collapse during sim or keep focus stable (investigate)
- Design: revise validation copy + add quick docs link (Sudha/Laura)
- Eva: verify with NVDA/VO once changes landed
Sudha Iyer: I'll update the acceptance criteria for the card. Please tag me on the PR so we can block rolling to prod until a11y sign-off. :white_check_mark:
Eva Sørensen: I'll run quick accessibility smoke tests after the PR lands.
Mike Patel: Uploaded a tiny screencap gif to the PR showing the focus ring flakiness. Screenshot link: https://redwood-internal.s3/sim-focus-gif.gif
Laura Chen: Thanks all. Small fixes but high impact. If anyone wants to pair on the live region wording, ping me. :sparkles:
